## Changes

### 1. Root `pom.xml` — dependency version bumps
- `jackson.version`: `2.15.2` → `2.17.1`

(All json-unit dependency declarations already reference this property, so no hardcoded versions needed changing.)

### 2. `MailboxEventSerializer.scala` — precise date-time error handling
Added a custom `implicit Reads[Instant]` before `messageMetaDataReads`:
```scala
implicit val instantReads: Reads[Instant] = {
  case JsString(value) => JsSuccess(Instant.parse(value))
  case _ => JsError()
}
```
Previously, `internalDate`/`saveDate` used play-json's default `Reads[Instant]`, which **catches** parse errors and returns `JsError` — so `.get()` in callers threw `NoSuchElementException`. Now `Instant.parse` runs uncaught, so an invalid date-time string propagates a `java.time.DateTimeException` (via its subclass `DateTimeParseException`). I verified empirically that `Instant.parse` accepts all the valid formats (`...Z`, `+00:00`, with/without millis) and rejects every invalid case in the test fixtures. Non-string values (null, etc.) still yield `JsError` → `NoSuchElementException`, preserving the structural-error semantics.

### 3. json-unit varargs migration (13 `src/main` JMAP contract Scala files)
json-unit 3.x removed `withOptions(Options)` in favor of the varargs `withOptions(Option, Option...)`:
